subject.title: [Bug] Race condition in approval-classifier.ts when tokenization exceeds max tokens

question: Can maintainers reproduce an ACP request that executes before its permission classification resolves, and should the report be transferred to a private GitHub Security Advisory?
rationale: The claimed impact crosses an approval boundary, but the public report lacks the concrete frames and observed execution needed to distinguish a vulnerability from an incorrect model of the current ACP flow.

options.title: Run private security reproduction
options.body: Move concrete exploit details to a private advisory and trace one controlled request from permission notification through classification and execution.

options.title: Request a minimal private reproducer
options.body: Ask the reporter for exact frames, configuration, timing evidence, and the unauthorized action before assigning implementation work.

options.title: Reclassify as hardening
options.body: If no boundary bypass is demonstrated, retain any useful concurrency concern as a lower-severity ACP hardening task rather than a vulnerability.

recommendation.title: Run private security reproduction
recommendation.body: Move concrete exploit details to a private advisory and trace one controlled request from permission notification through classification and execution.

likelyOwner.reason: Their history is most directly tied to semantic ACP approval classification and fail-closed identity handling.
